say:2:1710658001:1.text: Lady Monette, you must have been frightened. I remember you suffer from palpitations, so I had calming medicine prepared.
say:2:1710658001:1.source_cn: 梦妮夫人，您受惊了。我记得您向来有心悸症，我已命人为您...

say:3:1710658002:1.text: Your Highness is as considerate as ever. I'm fine, but today's scene was truly terrifying.
say:3:1710658002:1.source_cn: 殿下，您还是一如既往地体贴周到。我并无大碍，只是今日这...

say:4:1710658003:1.text: If not for Magister Merlin and Lady Gwyneth arriving in time, the outcome could have been disastrous.
say:4:1710658003:1.source_cn: 若不是梅林阁下和格温妮丝小姐及时赶到并出手相助，后果真...
say:4:1710658003:1.male: If not for Magister Merlin and Lady Gwyneth arriving in time, the outcome could have been disastrous.
say:4:1710658003:1.female: If not for Magister Merlin and Lady Gwyneth arriving in time, the outcome could have been disastrous.

say:5:1710658004:1.text: It reminded me of when Gwyneth brought down that earth drake. Just as brilliant.
say:5:1710658004:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝小姐今日的英姿，让我想起了她当年也是在这个猎场...

say:6:1710658005:1.text: Hendrik must be so proud. The family has a worthy successor!
say:6:1710658005:1.source_cn: 亨德里克教女有方，亨德里克家族后继有人啊！

say:7:1710658006:1.text: Indeed. The Lightbearer Empire is fortunate to have such devoted protectors.
say:7:1710658006:1.source_cn: 是啊，此次全赖格温妮丝和梅林阁下，我也为耀光能得此英勇...
say:7:1710658006:1.male: Indeed. The Lightbearer Empire is fortunate to have such devoted protectors.
say:7:1710658006:1.female: Indeed. The Lightbearer Empire is fortunate to have such devoted protectors.

say:8:1710658007:1.text: Well said, Your Highness. Truly fortunate!
say:8:1710658007:1.source_cn: 殿下说的没错，这真是耀光之幸啊！

say:9:1710658008:1.text: ... Yes. Please rest in your tent for now. I'll handle the aftermath here.
say:9:1710658008:1.source_cn: ……的确是幸事。请您先去帐中歇息吧，稳定心神。这里由我...
